messages:
jin: Heads-up — partnerX pushing a new model bundle we need to onboard (weights + tokenizer). s3 incoming: s3://incoming-uploads/partnerx/modelx_v1/ — can we confirm required ingest handshake?
maya: thanks. do we have their checksum + sig?
jin: they attached modelx_v1.pt, modelx_v1.pt.sig, tokenizer.json, vocab.txt and a SHA256 string in the email: 3b7f9c6a2d0e8f4a5b1f3e9c0f2a1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234
raoul: ok checklist I use: verify GPG signature -> verify checksum -> copy to secure ingest bucket with SSE-KMS -> write provenance record -> register model. Minimal commands: ```gpg --keyserver hkps://keys.openpgp.org --recv-keys DEADBEEF && gpg --verify modelx_v1.pt.sig modelx_v1.pt``` then ```sha256sum modelx_v1.pt```
sophie: partner must upload to presigned PUT URL we provide. TTL 1h. On our side, copy from incoming to redwood-ingest bucket and enable object lock retention 30d plus SSE-KMS (arn:arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12-3456). Also insist on a provenance.json manifest with fields: origin, upload_timestamp, source_commit, license, training_data_manifest_sha256, signer_fingerprint
jin: will request presigned URL and manifest template from partner. they sent GPG key id 0xDEADBEEF.
artifact-bot: INGEST: presigned URL created by ops. URL TTL=3600s.
maya: after we pull object into redwood-ingest, run quick verification and detach to registry staging: ```aws s3 cp s3://incoming-uploads/partnerx/modelx_v1/modelx_v1.pt ./ && sha256sum modelx_v1.pt # compare with partner value```
raoul: once verified, push to model registry: ```model-registry put --source s3://redwood-ingest/partnerx/modelx_v1/ --meta provenance.json --tags partner:partnerX,domain:vision``` registry returns model_id. capture model_id in ledger and SSM.
sophie: Ops: set parameter /models/partnerx/modelx_v1/registry-id and create KMS-wrapped DEK entry in the secrets ledger. Also add tokenizer files to tokenizer-registry with tokenizer_id linking to model entry.
ops: created ssm param placeholder. will fill after registry returns ID. can create KMS DEK after we get final object and confirm sig.
jin: QA/bench run notes: run baseline float32/float16 perf + quality evals (perplexity/top-k) and a quick rmse on logits; then schedule quantization experiments (post-training static int8 calibration with 512 calibration steps). name experiments qexp/<model_id>/int8-calib.
maya: for evals add eval-set v2 (500 examples) and track metric baseline -> newmodel delta. set alert if ems > 0.02 on top1 accuracy.
raoul: I'll handle quantization pipeline after the float16 pass. remember to keep a fallback variant in routing policy (hosted -> dedicated) in case perf regresses.
jin: final pre-onboard checklist: 1) GPG sig verified, 2) sha256 checked, 3) provenance.json present and uploaded, 4) objects in redwood-ingest with object-lock + SSE-KMS, 5) registry put returns model_id, 6) SSM/ledger entries written, 7) tokenizer registered, 8) smoke evals green, 9) quant experiments scheduled, 10) set rollout priority P2.
maya: I'll run checklist tomorrow morning and post results here. tagging @raoul and @ops. :thumbsup:
artifact-bot: INGEST COMPLETE: checks=OK, model_id=model-1815001, registry_url=https://registry.redwood.ai/models/model-1815001, provenance_record=https://ledger.redwood.ai/prov/model-1815001
